style.styleTitle: Lights4fun Chirstmas Pre Lit LED Outdoor Porch Bundle
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Give your guests a warm welcome this winter with this prelit outdoor porch bundle. Featuring a winter wreath, a matching garland, and two potted Christmas trees, all carefully crafted from faux foliage.</p><p>This festive bundle also features a total of 240 warm white micro LEDs across the four elements to ensure that your front porch is dressed in sparkly style for the season. Hang up the wreath on the front door and swag the garland above the door frame. </p><p>Then add the two trees to either side of the entrance to create an inviting and elegant glow at the entryway to your home.</p><p>Each component comes with its own battery&nbsp; box, and all pieces are made of antirust materials, designed for outdoor placement. </p><p>The bundle will need some styling upon arrival, so you can tailor the look of the foliage to your preference. To illuminate, simply add 3 x AA batteries to each attached battery box. Set the handy 6hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening.</p><ul><li>Size: ONE</li><li>Length: 25cm</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Give your guests a warm welcome this winter with this prelit outdoor porch bundle. Featuring a winter wreath, a matching garland, and two potted Christmas trees, all carefully crafted from faux foliage. This festive bundle also features a total of 240 warm white micro LEDs across the four elements to ensure that your front porch is dressed in sparkly style for the season. Hang up the wreath on the front door and swag the garland above the door frame. Then add the two trees to either side of the entrance to create an inviting and elegant glow at the entryway to your home. Each component comes with its own battery box, and all pieces are made of antirust materials, designed for outdoor placement. The bundle will need some styling upon arrival, so you can tailor the look of the foliage to your preference. To illuminate, simply add 3 x AA batteries to each attached battery box. Set the handy 6hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Size: ONE. Length: 25cm.
